content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 Notification
content_sections.text: Candidates should read the notification corresponding to their preferred cadre, as the educational qualifications, examination sequence and salary conditions are not identical across all advertised posts.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: GPRB has announced 13,152 vacancies across nine post categories. Unarmed Police Constable accounts for the largest share with 8,233 vacancies, followed by Armed Police Constable (SRPF) with 3,107 vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Constable Recruitment 2026 – 12,752 Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notification also provides horizontal reservation for eligible women and ex-servicemen in accordance with applicable recruitment rules.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Technical Cadre Recruitment 2026 – 159 Vacancies
content_sections.text: These reserved vacancies are included within the respective advertised totals and are not additional vacancies. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed disability suitability and certification requirements.

tables.caption: Technical Cadre Vacancies Reserved for Persons with Disabilities

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Category-Wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Reservation benefits are subject to the applicable Gujarat Government recruitment rules. The number of advertised vacancies may increase or decrease according to subsequent decisions of the recruitment authority.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police eligibility requirements differ according to the recruitment cadre. Lokrakshak posts require a Class 12 qualification, PSI Cadre posts require graduation, and Technical Cadre positions require Class 12 together with the prescribed Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade and apprenticeship qualifications. Candidates applying for Head Constable Driver Mechanic or Motor Transport Supervisor posts must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination. In addition, they must possess either of the following prescribed technical qualifications: Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate with one year of apprenticeship from the prescribed Government-recognized industrial training institution. Three-year apprenticeship certificate in Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme. Basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed under Gujarat Civil Services recruitment rules. Required knowledge of Gujarati, Hindi or both languages. Compliance with the applicable citizenship and character requirements. Possession of valid educational, reservation and additional qualification certificates by 16 December 2026. Compliance with the prescribed physical and medical fitness standards.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age eligibility will be determined as of 16 December 2026. The maximum age limit is 33 years for Lokrakshak and Head Constable Driver Mechanic posts, 35 years for PSI Cadre posts and 36 years for Motor Transport Supervisor posts. Additional disability-related age relaxations apply to eligible Technical Cadre candidates. Reserved-category benefits are available to eligible candidates belonging to the prescribed Gujarat categories, subject to valid supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected Gujarat Police candidates will initially receive fixed monthly remuneration under the applicable contractual appointment conditions. The Lokrakshak and Technical cadres carry a monthly fixed salary of Rs. 26,000, while the PSI Cadre carries Rs. 49,600 per month. The notifications provide for initial fixed-pay appointments under the applicable Government orders, generally for a five-year contractual period. Regular appointment in the applicable pay scale is subject to satisfactory completion of training, service and other prescribed conditions. The advertised amounts represent initial consolidated monthly pay rather than guaranteed in-hand salary under a regular pay scale.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: General category candidates must pay an examination fee of Rs. 100 along with applicable bank service charges. Eligible EWS, SC, ST, SEBC and ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the prescribed examination fee. The examination fee must be paid through the online payment facility on the OJAS portal. The last date for fee payment is 19 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Candidates liable to pay the examination fee must complete the payment for their valid confirmed applications within the prescribed deadline.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Physical Standards Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the minimum physical measurement requirements applicable to their selected cadre. The official notifications prescribe different height requirements for male and female candidates, including concessions for eligible Scheduled Tribe candidates of Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Physical Efficiency Test 2026 – Running Time
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) for Lokrakshak and PSI cadres is qualifying in nature. Candidates must complete the prescribed running distance within the permitted time to qualify for the subsequent Physical Standards Test. Candidates qualifying in the running test will undergo the prescribed physical measurement examination. Only candidates who qualify in both the Physical Efficiency Test and Physical Standards Test will progress to the written examination for the relevant cadre. The same running test should not automatically be assumed for Technical Cadre recruitment, which follows a different examination sequence.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: GPRB has prescribed different selection procedures for the Lokrakshak, PSI and Technical cadres. The Lokrakshak and PSI cadres begin with qualifying physical tests, while Technical Cadre recruitment begins with a written competitive examination. Final appointment is subject to the applicable merit, reservation, document verification, medical fitness and service-related requirements.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Constable Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police Lokrakshak written examination consists of 200 objective multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks. The examination duration is three hours, and candidates must achieve the minimum qualifying marks separately in Part A and Part B. Total Questions: 200. Maximum Marks: 200. Examination Duration: 180 Minutes. Marks for Each Correct Answer: 1. Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks. Minimum Qualifying Percentage: 40% separately in Part A and Part B.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police PSI Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police PSI Main Examination carries 300 marks and consists of two papers. Paper 1 is an objective General Studies examination, while Paper 2 assesses Gujarati and English language skills through descriptive questions. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks separately in Part A and Part B of Paper 1 and at least 40% marks in the descriptive Paper 2. Evaluation of the descriptive paper is subject to the qualifying requirements of Paper 1.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Technical Cadre Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination for Head Constable Driver Mechanic and Motor Transport Supervisor posts consists of 210 objective multiple-choice questions divided into two parts. Candidates will receive a combined examination duration of 180 minutes. Examination Mode: Objective MCQ using OMR. Total Questions: 210. Maximum Marks: 210. Examination Duration: 3 Hours. Minimum Qualifying Marks: 40% separately in Part A and Part B. Negative Marking: 0.25 Marks. Approximately twice the number of advertised vacancies will be called for document verification and physical standards testing based on the prescribed merit calculation.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Exam 2026 Negative Marking Rules
content_sections.text: GPRB has prescribed an Option E or Not Attempted response for objective examinations. Candidates who do not wish to answer a question should select this option instead of leaving the response blank. Candidates must carefully follow the examination instructions relating to OMR responses and prohibited corrections on the answer sheet.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: The minimum qualifying marks are calculated from the 40% qualifying standards specified in the official notifications. These marks should not be confused with the final recruitment cutoff, which will depend on merit, vacancies and applicable reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Driving Licence Requirements
content_sections.text: Certain Gujarat Police positions require candidates to possess or obtain the prescribed motor vehicle driving licence. The applicable licence conditions differ according to the post. Applicants should check the additional driving licence provisions applicable to their chosen Lokrakshak posts in the detailed recruitment notification.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Reservation and Additional Merit Marks
content_sections.text: The notifications contain applicable provisions relating to: Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, SEBC and EWS reservation. Horizontal reservation for eligible women. Ex-servicemen reservation. Disability reservation for specified Technical Cadre posts. Eligible sports certificate holders. Eligible widow candidates. NCC C certificate holders under applicable cadre provisions. Eligible qualifications from Rashtriya Raksha University and National Forensic Sciences University under applicable provisions.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online applications for all four Gujarat Police recruitment notifications begin on 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM and close on 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Candidates liable to pay the examination fee can complete the payment by 19 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Saving the online application alone does not complete the registration process. Candidates must confirm their applications and complete the applicable fee payment.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Application Form 2026 Photo and Signature Size
content_sections.text: GPRB has specified separate JPG image uploads for the candidate's recent colour passport-size photograph and signature. Each image must not exceed 15 KB. Candidates should verify that both uploaded images are clear and correctly displayed before confirming the application form.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the relevant certificates and supporting documents ready before completing the OJAS application form. The required documents vary depending on the cadre and eligibility claims. Class 10 certificate or applicable proof of date of birth. Class 12 certificate and mark sheet. Bachelor's Degree certificate and mark sheets for PSI Cadre applicants. Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade certificate for Technical Cadre applicants. Applicable apprenticeship certificate. Driving licence, wherever required. Valid Gujarat caste or reservation certificate, where applicable. SEBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. EWS eligibility certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate for eligible Technical Cadre applicants. Sports achievement certificate, where applicable. NCC C certificate, where applicable. Ex-servicemen certificate or supporting service records. Applicable widow certificate. Relevant additional qualification certificates. Recent colour photograph and signature. Confirmed online application form and examination fee receipt, where applicable. Certificates supporting educational qualifications, reservation and additional merit claims must satisfy the validity and issuance-date requirements prescribed in the respective notifications.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Application Confirmation Rules
content_sections.text: Candidates liable to pay the examination fee must ensure that the fee is paid against the valid confirmed application. Previously submitted applications and payments should not automatically be assumed to remain valid for a subsequent application. Applicants should download and preserve their confirmed application forms before the registration deadline, as the notifications state that the application form download facility will not remain available after the closing date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has announced 13,152 vacancies, comprising 12,752 Lokrakshak Cadre posts, 241 PSI Cadre posts, 133 Head Constable Driver Mechanic posts and 26 Motor Transport Supervisor posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat Police Bharti 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. The examination fee payment facility will remain available until 19 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When does Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 apply online start?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM through the official OJAS Gujarat website.

faq.question: Q4. Can 12th-pass candidates apply for Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Class 12 pass candidates can apply for 12,752 Lokrakshak Cadre vacancies, subject to the prescribed eligibility requirements. Technical Cadre posts also require Class 12, together with specified Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade and apprenticeship qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Gujarat Police PSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a bachelor's degree from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Gujarat Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit for Lokrakshak Cadre recruitment is 18 to 33 years as of 16 December 2026. Upper age relaxation applies to eligible candidates according to the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for Gujarat Police PSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for PSI Cadre recruitment is 35 years as of 16 December 2026, subject to applicable age relaxation provisions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the Gujarat Police Constable salary in 2026?
faq.answer: Selected Lokrakshak Cadre candidates will initially receive fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 26,000 under the prescribed appointment conditions.

faq.question: Q9. What is the Gujarat Police PSI salary in 2026?
faq.answer: Selected PSI Cadre candidates will initially receive consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 49,600 during the five-year contractual appointment period.

faq.question: Q10. What is the Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 application fee?
faq.answer: General category candidates must pay Rs. 100 plus applicable bank charges. Eligible EWS, SEBC, SC, ST and ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the examination fee.
